title: A New Lunar Crater: McGetchin
explanation:
# A Whale-Sized Cosmic Collision Leaves Its Mark

A space rock the size of a humpback whale slammed into the Moon between April and May 2024, blasting out a crater as wide as two soccer fields—a catastrophic impact so rare that astronomers expect to witness one only once every 132 years. NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter captured the cosmic before-and-after, revealing not just the crater itself but a sprawling cold zone around it where the Moon's pulverized surface became too fluffy and porous to hold onto heat, like fresh snow reflecting away warmth.
